events.label: birth
events.text: Adrian Dietrich Lothar von Trotha born in Magdeburg.

evidence.quote: General Adrian Dietrich Lothar von Trotha ( 3 July 1848
Born in Magdeburg , the capital of the Province of Saxony

events.text: Married Bertha Neumann, his first marriage.

evidence.quote: on 15 October 1872 he married Bertha Neumann
He married Bertha Neumann on 15 October 1872
before he was deployed to Africa in 1894

events.text: Appointed commander of colonial forces in German East Africa.

evidence.quote: In 1894 Trotha was appointed commander of the colonial forces in German East Africa

events.text: Appointed Commander in Chief of German South West Africa.

evidence.quote: On 3 May 1904 he was appointed Commander in Chief of German South West Africa
Trotha arrived in South West Africa on 11 June 1904

events.text: Devised a new battle plan against the Herero uprisings.

evidence.quote: In October 1904 General von Trotha devised a new battle plan

events.text: Sent a message to the Nama suggesting surrender.

evidence.quote: On 22 April 1905 he sent a message to the Nama

events.text: Returned to Germany from South West Africa.

evidence.quote: On 19 November 1905 Lothar von Trotha returned to Germany
was appointed as an infantry general in 1910

events.text: Married Lucy Goldstein-Brinckmann, a second marriage.

evidence.quote: on 19 May 1912 , he married Lucy Goldstein-Brinckmann

events.label: death
events.text: Died of typhoid fever in Bonn.

evidence.quote: He died of typhoid fever ( bilious fever ) on 31 March 1920 in Bonn

undated_mentions: Commander of Lauenburgisches Jäger Bataillon Nr. 9 in Ratzeburg for two years
Fought in the Austro-Prussian and Franco-Prussian Wars
Involvement in suppressing the Boxer Rebellion as brigade commander of the East Asian Expedition Corps
Suppression of the Wahehe Rebellion in German East Africa
Encirclement orders at the Battle of Waterberg
Asked by the Imperial Chancellor to be relieved of command
